generation: P5 (disc, July 2024 onward; FM148 frame, sold as MY2025-2027)
identify: Six sizes including a 61, 34 mm tyre clearance, HB15 basebar on a Bayonet fork with no stem, EX14 riser whose extension cradle tilts 0-30 deg in 5 deg steps. The 2019-2023 P5 Disc has five sizes, 28 mm tyres and an EX11 or EX10 riser that tilts at most 15 deg.

cockpit.steerer: Proprietary Bayonet fork with one-piece basebar interface; no standard stem.
cockpit.stem: None: HB15 basebar bolts to the fork; pad stack comes from the EX14 riser post (HBP-EX14-RISER) in the P5 riser post clamp.
cockpit.stack_system: Basebar stack from 'slammed' to +40 mm in 5 mm steps (basebar 10 mm lower than the 2019 P5 at its base setting). Stock HBP-045 hardware (45 mm screws) covers 0-20 mm; higher settings need the extra HBP-065 kit (65 mm screws). Pad height above that comes from the EX14 riser post (may be trimmed; keep at least 80 mm inside the fork).
cockpit.reach_system: EX10 pad mount attaches in two positions on the riser; pads are longer and larger than the 2019 P5 with more fore-aft travel and a much more rearward setting (Fit Werx). Basebar reach is 10 mm shorter than 2019.
cockpit.angle_system: EX14 curved cradle with insert: forward 0/10/20/30 deg, reversed 5/15/25 deg (seven settings, 0-30 deg). 2019 P5 stopped at 15 deg.
cockpit.notes: Cervélo's manual warns that specific basebar stack hardware kits must be used for specific stack ranges and only the supplied basebar-to-fork screws. Slowtwitch and Fit Werx: accepts aftermarket 22.2 mm extensions and third-party pads. Major reach changes beyond the pad positions are limited compared with a stem bike (owner comparison with the P-Series).

parts.model: HBP-065 basebar stack hardware kit (65 mm screws)

effect.text: Longer basebar screws for the upper part of the +40 mm basebar stack range; stock HBP-045 screws cover 0-20 mm.

evidence.says: 2024 P5 (FM148) manual: standard kit HBP-045 for 0-20 mm, extra kit HBP-065; specific stack hardware kits must be used for specific stack ranges.
Stack beyond the base range (an additional 20-40 mm) requires a separate spacer bolt kit.

parts.needs: Basebar spacers for the chosen height; use only Cervélo-supplied basebar-to-fork screws.

parts.model: 22.2 mm aftermarket extensions in the stock EX14 clamps

effect.text: Swap extension shape (ski bend, grip angle, length) without changing the riser; tilt still set by the EX14 cradle.

evidence.says: Launch article relaying Cervélo: aerobar compatible with all aftermarket 22.2 mm extensions.
Cervélo dealer/fitter: the new P5 accommodates many third-party pads and extensions.

parts.needs: Cut to length; Di2 routing through the extensions as per the manual.

effect.text: Metal plate replacing the Cervélo pad/extension mount so standard risers, extensions and a solid BTA mount can be used; adjustment depends on the bars fitted.

evidence.says: Search result of TriRig's product page: the Cervélo plate only works with Cervélo EX10 and EX14 mono posts.

parts.needs: Bolt pattern does not match FastTT risers/bars (see incompatible record).

parts.model: Adapter kit / plate for Cervélo P5 Disc & P3X

effect.text: Replaces the EX14 mounting plate so FastTT risers and extensions fit; retailer gives max plate tilt 30 deg on EX14 (absolute).

evidence.says: Retailer reproduces FastTT's listing: compatible with P5 Disc and P3X (EX10 / EX14); screws included; EUR 162.35 at that shop.
Search result: replaces the EX10/EX14 mounting plate; max tilt 30 deg on EX14.
Owner of a MY26 P5 Disc (Sept 2026) set it up with no problems, using FastTT's adjustable BTA adapter.

parts.needs: FastTT risers/extensions; FastTT BTA bracket or adjustable BTA adapter for a bottle. One owner dislikes the non-standard bolt spacing.

parts.model: Ascalon adapter, Cervélo P5 Disc EX14

effect.text: Tilt-adjustable adapter for Ascalon extensions, 15-40 deg in 5 deg steps (absolute) - beyond the stock 30 deg.

evidence.says: P5 Disc EX14 adapter, requires EX14 monopost, 15-40 deg in 5 deg steps; only for Ascalon extensions; GBP 115 base + GBP 252.50 option incl. VAT.

parts.needs: AeroCoach Ascalon extensions. Settings above 30 deg may break UCI rules (retailers cite a 30 deg cap); check race rules. Price = base plus Cervélo option as listed, incl. 20% VAT.

parts.model: Third-party arm pads / cups on the stock pad rests

effect.text: Pad/cup swap; no maker-specific range given.

evidence.says: Cervélo dealer/fitter: accommodates many third-party pads, as the previous P5 did.
Arm cups fix to the riser pad rests with two M5 screws, fore-aft (not diagonal), 4 Nm; both screws always fitted.

parts.needs: A cup with a two-screw fore-aft pattern matching the rests; pattern spacing not published in sources reached.

parts.model: Super-X plate combined with FastTT risers/bars

effect.text: Bolt holes do not line up.

parts.reason_incompatible: Owner moving from a MY19/20 to a MY24 P5 Disc found the Super-X hole spacing does not line up with FastTT risers/bars; FastTT needs its own P5 adapter plate.

evidence.says: Owner (Sept 2026): TriRig plate hole spacing does not line up for his FastTT bars.
Same owner (Feb 2026): with FastTT risers/bars the Super-X bolt patterns are a bit off; the plate is specific to EX10/EX11/EX14 monoposts.

gaps: No per-size pad stack/reach table: cervelo.com (size finder, back-of-pad reference per search text) returned HTTP 429 earlier and was not retried; stock_range left empty.
Stock extensions differ by source: the 2024 manual lists Cervélo EX14 35-deg extensions (HBP-EX14-EXT35D), the frameset spec lists Profile Design 52ASC.
Arm-cup bolt spacing on the EX14 pad rests not published in the sources reached.
Whether 2019-2023 P5 Disc EX10/EX11 riser posts or HB basebars fit the 2024 fork: no source found (the 2024 manual reuses the EX10 pad mount part, HBP-EX10-PADMT).
Few owner reports specific to the 2024+ P5; Slowtwitch posts about Super-X, 51 Speedshop and Vision TFE on 'P5' mostly do not state the generation and were not used here.
Vision Metron TFE adapter for the EX14: not found.
